name: Park Ji-hye
bio:
Park Ji-hye is a seasoned head of operations with over 15 years of experience in motorsport. Her journey began with a passion for engineering and a fascination with the intricate mechanics of racing cars. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from KAIST, she started her career as a junior engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to her exceptional technical skills and meticulous attention to detail.

Ji-hye's approach to operations is rooted in a pragmatic and data-driven methodology. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best work. Her unique ability to blend technical expertise with strong management skills allows her to streamline processes, optimize resource allocation, and drive continuous improvement. She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her unwavering commitment to achieving operational excellence. Her experience and detail-oriented nature have made her a highly sought-after leader in the industry.

What distinguishes Ji-hye is her innovative approach to problem-solving. Although her innovation score is slightly lower than her other skills, she continuously seeks out ways to improve and challenge existing methods, making her a valuable asset to any team looking to gain a competitive edge.
